title: Enforcement.*
officialText:
Officers and employees of the department and of other city agencies designated by the commissioner shall have the power to issue notices of violation, administrative summonses and appearance tickets for violations of applicable affordable housing provisions.

(L.L. 2022/045, 1/15/2022, eff. 7/14/2022)
